pairing_before.expression: (() => { const research = idleon.getAttr("Research"); return { levels: research[0], owners: research[1], placements: research[6], found: research[2], insightLevels: research[4], crowns: research[11], trades: research[12], researchLevel: Number(idleon.getAttr("Lv0")[20]), artifactStatus: Number(idleon.getAttr("Sailing")[3][37]), researchMerit: Number(idleon.getAttr("Tasks")[2][6][3]), rift: idleon.getAttr("Rift"), accumulatedReduction: Number(idleon.getAttr("OptionsListAccount")[499]), spelunkingReduction: Number(idleon.getAttr("OptionsListAccount")[500]) }; })()

catalogue.expression: idleon.getAttr("CustomLists").h.ResGridSquares.map((square, index) => ({ index, name: square[0], template: square[5], cap: idleon.callFunction("ResearchStuff","Grid_MaxLV",index,0), level: idleon.callFunction("ResearchStuff","Grid_Bonus",index,1), primary: idleon.callFunction("ResearchStuff","Grid_Bonus",index,0), secondary: idleon.callFunction("ResearchStuff","Grid_Bonus",index,2), reachable: idleon.callFunction("ResearchStuff","Grid_CanWeSelect",index,0), canUpgrade: idleon.callFunction("ResearchStuff","Grid_CanWeUpgrade",index,0) })).filter(square => square.name !== "Name")

boats.expression: idleon.getAttr("Boats").map((boat, index) => ({ index, lootUpgrades: Number(boat[3]), speedUpgrades: Number(boat[5]), qualifies: Number(boat[3])+Number(boat[5])>=400 ? 1 : 0, frame: idleon.callFunction("Sailing","BoatFrame",index,0) }))

shape_static.expression: (() => { const definitions = idleon.getAttr("CustomLists").h.Research; return { vertices: definitions[0], dimensions: definitions[1], names: definitions[3], modifiers: definitions[5] }; })()

descriptions.expression: (() => { const squares=idleon.getAttr("CustomLists").h.ResGridSquares; return squares.map((square,index) => { let text=""+square[5]; const primary=Math.round(100*idleon.callFunction("ResearchStuff","Grid_Bonus",index,0))/100; const secondary=idleon.callFunction("ResearchStuff","Grid_Bonus",index,2); text=text.replace(/{/g,primary>100 ? idleon.callFunction("CommaNotation",primary) : idleon.callFunction("NotateNumber",primary,"Small")); text=text.replace(/}/g,(""+idleon.callFunction("NotateNumber",1+primary/100,"MultiplierInfo")).replace("#","")); text=text.replace(/\$/g,idleon.callFunction("CommaNotation",secondary)); text=text.replace(/\^/g,(""+idleon.callFunction("NotateNumber",1+secondary/100,"MultiplierInfo")).replace("#","")); text=text.replace(/&/g,""+(Math.floor(1e4*(1-1/(1+Number(idleon.getAttr("OptionsListAccount")[499])/100)))/100)); text=text.replace(/\|/g,""+Math.round(idleon.callFunction("ResearchStuff","Grid_Bonus",index,1))); if(index===173)text=text.replace("<",idleon.callFunction("Companions",0)===1 ? "Arctis_nods_in_approval..._all_Research_Grid_bonuses_are_1.05x_higher" : "You_are_now_permanently_linked_to_Arctis_on_all_characters."); return {index,text}; }).filter(entry=>squares[entry.index][0]!=="Name"); })()
